title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Faceted counters**: You can now facet a counter visualization to show one counter tile per dimension value. See [Faceting](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/visualizations#faceting).
* **Legend cross-filtering**: Selecting an item in a visualization's legend now applies cross-filtering. See [Apply cross-filtering](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/filters#cross-filter).
* **Dashboard task page selection and tabular attachments**: Dashboard tasks in jobs can now optionally include dashboard page selection and tabular attachments. See [Configure a dashboard task](/aws/en/jobs/tasks/dashboard#configure-a-dashboard-task).
* **Date filter month picker fix**: Fixed a bug where the month drop-down menu on date filters did not respect your dark or light mode preference.
